question: Find the difference in total view counts between posts with 'statistics' in the title authored by users who earned a 'Teacher' badge within one year of account creation versus those who earned it after five years.

prediction.sql:
WITH teacher_badges AS (
    SELECT 
        b.XCL_002 AS user_id,
        b.XCL_004 AS badge_date,
        u.XCL_054 AS creation_date
    FROM badges b
    JOIN users u ON b.XCL_002 = u.XCL_052
    WHERE b.XCL_003 = 'Teacher'
),
categorized_users AS (
    SELECT 
        user_id,
        CASE 
            WHEN (julianday(badge_date) - julianday(creation_date)) <= 365 THEN 'within_one_year'
            WHEN (julianday(badge_date) - julianday(creation_date)) > 5 * 365 THEN 'after_five_years'
        END AS category
    FROM teacher_badges
),
post_views AS (
    SELECT 
        cu.category,
        SUM(p.XCL_030) AS total_views
    FROM posts p
    JOIN categorized_users cu ON p.XCL_033 = cu.user_id
    WHERE p.XCL_035 LIKE '%statistics%'
      AND cu.category IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY cu.category
)
SELECT 
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN category = 'within_one_year' THEN total_views ELSE 0 END), 0) -
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN category = 'after_five_years' THEN total_views ELSE 0 END), 0) AS difference
FROM post_views

WITH teacher_badges AS (
    SELECT 
        b.XCL_002 AS user_id,
        b.XCL_004 AS badge_date,
        u.XCL_054 AS creation_date
    FROM badges b
    JOIN users u ON b.XCL_002 = u.XCL_052
    WHERE b.XCL_003 = 'Teacher'
),
categorized_users AS (
    SELECT 
        user_id,
        CASE 
            WHEN (julianday(badge_date) - julianday(creation_date)) <= 365 THEN 'within_one_year'
            WHEN (julianday(badge_date) - julianday(creation_date)) > 5 * 365 THEN 'after_five_years'
        END AS category
    FROM teacher_badges
),
post_views AS (
    SELECT 
        cu.category,
        SUM(p.XCL_030) AS total_views
    FROM posts p
    JOIN categorized_users cu ON p.XCL_033 = cu.user_id
    WHERE p.XCL_035 LIKE '%statistics%'
      AND cu.category IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY cu.category
)
SELECT 
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN category = 'within_one_year' THEN total_views ELSE 0 END), 0) -
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN category = 'after_five_years' THEN total_views ELSE 0 END), 0) AS difference
FROM post_views
